title: Prefixes and two words
goal: Strike the beginning on its own, then the word you know with the join key held. Or join two whole words.

blocks.x: *over-* and *under-* are the words themselves: [[overcome|AUFR/+KUPL]]. *dis-* and *mis-* are words too.

`ex-` and `dis-` have keys of their own that join the next stroke's left hand, so the word stays one stroke: [[expect|KPEBGT]], [[distance|STKUPBS]]. `un-`, `mis-`, `over-`, `under-` and `inter-` fold the same way when their keys fit. When they clash with the stem's own keys, the prefix is a stroke of its own, as above.
You do not need to know which. Both are in the dictionary; the prefix stroke always works.
A word that is two words is the two words, second one joined: [[myself|PHAOEU/+SEFL]], [[outside|OUT/+SAOEUD]]. This works for any compound you can split: *sun* + *light*.

blocks.title: Prefix, then stem
blocks.x: Five joined words. Hold Q with the second stroke.
